description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipAPI class, which implements API endpoints for managing employee memberships within an HR system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee membership records, integrating with services and models specific to employee memberships.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for employee membership records, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee membership record by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for getOne method parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all memberships of a specific employee, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for getAll method parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee membership record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new employee membership.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for create and update requests.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee membership record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an employee membership.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee memberships based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete requests.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Helper method to create or update an EmployeeMembership entity based on request data.
